The main takeaway from our work is that

the electrochemical behavior of these electrodes is complex and that the oxygen reduction process is not the only reaction occurring under cathodic polarization, even at temperatures as low as 600 °C.
the reduction of the iron oxide phase in L78SF and L78SCF is the rate-limiting step of the oxygen reduction process in these cathode materials.
the electrochemical reduction of the perovskite cathodes is not only due to reduction of the B-sites, but also to oxygen reduction.
